name: Plastic Bottle
action: Empty the bottle and place it with recyclable/inorganic waste according to your local collection system.

name: Battery
action: Do not mix it with regular household waste. Use an appropriate collection point.

name: Paper / Cardboard
action: Keep it dry and flat, and put it with recyclable waste.

name: Glass Bottle
action: Rinse it and keep it separate. Wrap broken glass in paper first.

name: Electronic Item
action: Do not put it in the bin. Take it to an electronics collection point.

name: Metal Can
action: Rinse it and place it with recyclable waste.

name: Old Clothes
action: Consider donating or reusing before disposal.

name: Plastic Packaging
action: Keep it dry and put it with inorganic waste, not with wet food waste.

name: Medicine
action: Do not throw it in regular waste. Return it to a pharmacy.
